title: Solve a quadratic equation by factoring

section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Quadratic Equations, Functions, Zeros, and Models

process_card: Solving a quadratic equation by factoring

mistakes.name: sign slip
mistakes.message: Sign slip: the factor (x - 3) = 0 gives x = 3, not -3.

mistakes.name: only one solution
mistakes.message: Each factor gives its own solution; you have only one.

mistakes.name: factored before getting 0 on one side
mistakes.message: Get 0 on one side first: the principle of zero products only works for a product equal to 0.

hints.hint: Move every term to the left side so the right side is 0.
hints.why: The principle of zero products only works when a product equals 0.

hints.hint: Find two binomials whose product is the left side; check by multiplying back.
hints.why: A product of factors is what lets you split one equation into two small ones.

hints.hint: Write each factor = 0 on its own line.
hints.why: Principle of zero products: if ab = 0, then a = 0 or b = 0.

hints.hint: Solve each small linear equation for x.
Substitute each solution into the original equation.
hints.why: A check catches sign slips and arithmetic errors before you submit.
